text:
anya: FYI onboarding created two projects for the same user during a flaky DB window. Quickstart uses the Python SDK to create demo projects and we saw duplicates.

liam: Do we have logs or an example run? Sounds like a retry doing a POST twice.

anya: Yep. Log snippet: ```2026-02-10T18:02:11Z INFO create_project request_id=abc123 status=500
2026-02-10T18:02:12Z INFO create_project retrying attempt=1
2026-02-10T18:02:12Z INFO create_project request_id=def456 status=201 project_id=proj_9x4```

anya: The sampleapp curl in docs shows using `Idempotency-Key` header for the same flow. Our SDK create_project doesn't accept an idempotency_key param and the client-side retry wrapper retries on 5xx, so server ended up creating two projects.

henry: Oof. Docs vs SDK mismatch again. Docs include: `curl -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMP" -d '{...}' /projects` but SDK hides headers.

liam: SDK should expose a top-level `idempotency_key` optional param for create_* admin methods that sets the header. Minimal change. Also we should default the HTTP retry middleware to only retry idempotent methods or require explicit idempotency for POSTs.

sam: Agreed. Two action items: 1) quick fix in sampleapp to generate and pass an Idempotency-Key using the REST fallback; 2) SDK change to accept `idempotency_key` and plumb it to headers, plus unit test asserting header is present on retry.

anya: For the sampleapp fallback I'm doing this: ```py
headers = { 'Authorization': f"Bearer {TOKEN}", 'Idempotency-Key': str(uuid.uuid4()) }
requests.post(f"{API_BASE}/projects", json=body, headers=headers)
```

henry: Can we also add an integration test that simulates transient 500 and ensures the SDK sends the same idempotency key on retry (so server dedupes)?

liam: Yes. I'll open a PR with tests and a small API change: `create_project(body, *, idempotency_key=None)` which sets header if provided. Also will change retry policy to not automatically retry POST without idempotency_key.

devex-bot: Created issue #445: "Python SDK: add idempotency_key param for create_* methods and avoid unsafe POST retries" assigned to @liam. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/445 :eyes:

anya: Great. Deploying sampleapp fallback now so live quickstarts aren't creating duplicates.

liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/1023  adds idempotency_key param + tests. Requesting review from @sam and @henry.

sam: Thanks. We'll also update the quickstart doc to call out idempotency usage in onboarding flows.
